Random Tactical Timer

Random Tactical Timer is a native iOS and Android random-interval training app for MMA, BJJ, boxing, muay thai, HIIT, and tactical reaction drills. The timer fires at an unpredictable moment inside a range you choose so athletes cannot anticipate the cue.

Preferred agent format: markdown URLs below.
Base URL: https://igorganapolsky.github.io/Random-Timer

## Direct answers

- What is Random Tactical Timer? A random interval / reaction timer that triggers inside your min–max range instead of on a fixed round clock.
- Who is it for? Combat athletes, coaches, and tactical trainers who need unpredictable cues.
- Is it free to start? Yes. Core timer setup and alarm controls work free; Pro unlocks spoken countdown cue packs.
- Platforms? iPhone (App Store) and Android (Google Play), package `com.iganapolsky.randomtimer`.

## How it differs from fixed timers

- Fixed Tabata / round timers train rhythm. Random Tactical Timer trains reaction by removing anticipation.
- Compared with SmartFight Timer and PB Intervals: Random Tactical Timer focuses on a single job — random trigger inside a range — with native lock-screen persistence on both platforms.
